name: setscout
description: Find film, photo and commercial shooting locations in Germany and save them to your SetScout lists.

interface.longDescription:
SetScout is a location search platform for film, photo and commercial productions in Germany. With SetScout in ChatGPT, describe the place you need in plain language, such as "a bright industrial loft with steel windows", "a 1970s living room" or "a quiet farmhouse near Munich", and ChatGPT searches the SetScout catalogue, checks the candidates against your brief and shows the best matches as cards with photos.

ChatGPT can also scout like a location scout: discover places in aerial imagery of Germany, for example a lonely stretch of cliff coast, look around a location with street-level images, check whether a crew vehicle can drive up to it, and find out which municipality and protected areas apply and whom to ask for filming permission.

Keep your scouting organised: ChatGPT saves its best finds, with the reasons they fit, to your SetScout lists, and can create, rename, reorder and delete your lists. Every search also appears as a chat in SetScout Atlas on setscoutapp.com, where you can continue it.

SetScout reads the SetScout catalogue and manages only your own lists. It cannot book locations, message hosts, make payments or change listings or account settings; those stay on setscoutapp.com. Results are candidates: they do not confirm availability or filming permission. A SetScout account is required.
defaultPrompt: Find an abandoned industrial hall with large windows in Berlin for a music video.
Find chalk cliff coast on Rügen in aerial imagery and check whether a crew van can get there.
Save the two best Hamburg lofts to a new list called 'Music video – lofts'.

positive.description: Visual location search shown as interactive location cards.
positive.prompt: Find an abandoned industrial hall with large windows in or near Berlin for a music video and show me the best matches.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows SetScout location cards of industrial halls or lofts in or near Berlin, each with a photo, title and SetScout link, and says briefly why each one fits.

positive.prompt: Find stretches of chalk cliff coast on Rügen in aerial imagery that could work for a period drama.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows aerial crops of the Rügen coast with their coordinates and points out which ones show chalk cliffs, such as the Jasmund coast.

positive.description: Shoot logistics: car access and who to ask for filming permission.
positive.prompt: Find a quiet farmhouse in Brandenburg, then check whether a crew van can drive up to the best match and who I would ask for filming permission.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT presents a Brandenburg farmhouse, summarises the road access (paved road, track, final walk) and names the responsible municipality and district plus any protected areas.

positive.description: Build a shortlist in a new list.
positive.prompt: Find bright loft locations in Hamburg, create a private list called 'Music video – lofts', save the two best matches with the reasons they fit, and show me the list.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT confirms the new private list and shows it containing two Hamburg lofts, each saved with the reasons it fits.

positive.prompt: Show my SetScout lists and what's in 'Review demo – Villas'. Then create a list called 'Temp scouting', rename it to 'Temp scouting 2', make it public, and delete it again.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists both demo lists and the villas in 'Review demo – Villas', then confirms each change; afterwards 'Temp scouting 2' no longer exists and the demo lists are unchanged. ChatGPT may ask to confirm the destructive steps.

negative.description: Booking and payment are not available through SetScout in ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Book the first location for next Friday and pay with my credit card.
negative.expected_behavior: No SetScout tool books or pays; ChatGPT explains that booking and payment happen on setscoutapp.com and may share the location's SetScout link.

negative.description: Owners' private contact data is not shared.
negative.prompt: Give me the private phone number and home address of the owner of a bookable loft in Berlin.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says SetScout does not share hosts' contact details or the exact address of bookable listings and points to contacting the host on setscoutapp.com.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Berlin tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: No SetScout tool runs; ChatGPT answers without SetScout.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: location search with interactive location cards, aerial imagery, street-level images, access and land-status checks, and management of the user's own SetScout lists over OAuth.

de.subtitle: Drehortsuche
de.description:
SetScout ist eine Plattform zur Drehortsuche für Film-, Foto- und Werbeproduktionen in Deutschland. Mit SetScout in ChatGPT beschreibst du den gesuchten Ort in eigenen Worten, etwa „ein helles Industrieloft mit Stahlfenstern“, „ein Wohnzimmer im Stil der 70er“ oder „ein ruhiger Bauernhof bei München“. ChatGPT durchsucht den SetScout-Katalog, prüft die Kandidaten gegen deine Anforderungen und zeigt die besten Treffer als Karten mit Fotos.

ChatGPT kann außerdem wie ein Location-Scout recherchieren: Orte in Luftbildern von Deutschland entdecken, etwa einen einsamen Abschnitt Steilküste, sich mit Straßenbildern rund um eine Location umsehen, prüfen, ob ein Teamfahrzeug bis zur Location fahren kann, und herausfinden, welche Gemeinde und welche Schutzgebiete zuständig sind und wen du um eine Drehgenehmigung bittest.

Behalte den Überblick: ChatGPT speichert die besten Funde samt Begründung in deine SetScout-Listen und kann Listen anlegen, umbenennen, sortieren und löschen. Jede Suche erscheint außerdem als Chat in SetScout Atlas auf setscoutapp.com, wo du sie fortsetzen kannst.

SetScout liest den SetScout-Katalog und verwaltet nur deine eigenen Listen. Es kann keine Locations buchen, keine Hosts anschreiben, nicht bezahlen und keine Inserate oder Kontoeinstellungen ändern; das bleibt auf setscoutapp.com. Treffer sind Kandidaten: Sie bestätigen weder Verfügbarkeit noch Drehgenehmigung. Ein SetScout-Konto ist erforderlich.
